instruction: Write an XDP program that inspects network traffic and must drop packets from quarantined source IP addresses registered in BPF_MAP_TYPE_LRU_HASH map 'quarantine_map'. Forward all other packets with XDP_PASS.
requirements: Define BPF_MAP_TYPE_LRU_HASH map 'quarantine_map' with key __u32 and max_entries 1024
Verify Ethernet and IPv4 header bounds against data_end
Drop packet with XDP_DROP if lookup succeeds
SEC("xdp") entry point and GPL license declaration
